rationale: With only 22 minutes to close and an automatic liquidation at market, the risk/reward is unfavorable: the stock gapped down ~11.6% on earnings and has recovered to the top 90% of today's range, suggesting much of the post-earnings bounce has already occurred. The 1-minute candles show momentum stalling near $206 with declining volume on the most recent bar, and the ATR of ~$1.05 on 5-minute bars makes it difficult to set a meaningful stop without excessive risk relative to available take-profit room before the close forces liquidation.
